a.summary: git auto-merged this three-line initializer straight from main (it is main-only text; v1_tx never had it), so it still hard-codes `":0"`. With hunk 1 resolved take-ours, this literal — not the conflict region — is what actually decides the version sent for `getBlock`, so v1_tx's `MAX_SUPPORTED_TRANSACTION_VERSION = 1` would silently have no effect on block requests: full blocks would still be requested at v0 while `getTransaction` asked for v1, an inconsistency that also makes the class's constant half-dead. Note the same value change is asserted verbatim by two test files that main added and v1_tx does not have, so after applying this fix also update sava-rpc/src/test/java/software/sava/rpc/json/http/client/ClientDefaultsRpcRequestTests.java line 194 (`"maxSupportedTransactionVersion":0}]}` -> `"maxSupportedTransactionVersion":1}]}`) and sava-rpc/src/test/java/software/sava/rpc/json/http/client/RoundTripRpcRequestTests.java line 965 (`"maxSupportedTransactionVersion":0,"encoding"` -> `"maxSupportedTransactionVersion":1,"encoding"`); do not edit those two test files as part of this file's resolution, but they must change in the same commit or `:sava-rpc:test` fails.

b.summary: VERIFIED CONCERN (find-text matches the working tree exactly). git auto-merged this three-line initializer straight from main — it is main-only text introduced by 0d68f02 and v1_tx never had it — so it still hard-codes `":0"`. With hunk 1 resolved take-ours this literal, not the conflict region, is what decides the version sent for `getBlock`, so v1_tx's `MAX_SUPPORTED_TRANSACTION_VERSION = 1` would silently have no effect on block requests: full blocks would be requested at v0 while `getTransaction` asked for v1, and the class constant would be half-dead. Note for future maintenance (no edit needed now): the `== BlockTxDetails.full` condition is correct only because sava's `BlockTxDetails` enum lacks an `accounts` constant; agave's `TransactionDetails::Accounts` arm does version-check via `build_json_accounts`, so if that constant is ever added the condition must widen. Two main-added test files assert the value verbatim and must change in the same commit or `:sava-rpc:test` fails — sava-rpc/src/test/java/software/sava/rpc/json/http/client/ClientDefaultsRpcRequestTests.java line 194 (`"maxSupportedTransactionVersion":0}]}` -> `"maxSupportedTransactionVersion":1}]}`) and sava-rpc/src/test/java/software/sava/rpc/json/http/client/RoundTripRpcRequestTests.java line 965 (`"maxSupportedTransactionVersion":0,"encoding"` -> `"maxSupportedTransactionVersion":1,"encoding"`); a repo-wide grep confirms those are the only two test assertions on this parameter.

instructions.question: How does the defect described by `b` relate to the defect described by `a`?
instructions.focus: Compare the defects, not the wording. Two findings about the same code can still be different defects.

criteria: Different defects: fixing the defect `a` describes would leave the defect `b` describes unfixed, even when both sit in the same code.
The same underlying defect, but `b` narrows it, re-scopes which instances or inputs it covers, or reports it at a different place. Not a different defect in adjacent code.
The same defect restated in different words: fixing one fixes the other.

claims_new_evidence.instructions: Does `b` cite evidence that `a` does not?

criteria.true: `b` names a file, test, command, observation, or reproduction that `a` does not mention.
criteria.false: `b` cites nothing beyond what `a` already cites, or cites nothing at all.
